title: Refund Policy and Process
content: CloudDash offers a 14-day money-back guarantee for all new Pro subscriptions. If you cancel your subscription within 14 days of your initial purchase, you are eligible for a full refund. To request a refund, please navigate to Billing → Subscription and click 'Cancel Subscription', then submit a refund request ticket. For billing disputes or issues such as duplicate charges, we issue refunds outside the 14-day window upon reviewing transaction logs. If you want to speak to a manager or escalate a billing dispute, our support agents will create a P1 priority escalation ticket for the finance operations team. Our finance department reviews all disputed charges within 48 hours.
